findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_available_themes, get_pricing_and_credit_packs, check_credit_balance · Private data: get_available_themes, get_pricing_and_credit_packs, check_credit_balance, create_photo_job · Public sink: create_photo_job · Destructive: get_available_themes, get_pricing_and_credit_packs, check_credit_balance, create_photo_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_available_themes, get_pricing_and_credit_packs, check_credit_balance · Private data: get_available_themes, get_pricing_and_credit_packs, check_credit_balance, create_photo_job · Public sink: create_photo_job · Destructive: get_available_themes, get_pricing_and_credit_packs, check_credit_balance, create_photo_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
